name: agentic-sales-engine
description: Agentic B2B sales engine: define your ICP, discover and score prospects with cited evidence, find ways in, and prep outreach and calls. Knowledge lives in a git-tracked markdown workspace.

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API key
EXA_API_KEY.description: Used for company/people discovery, news and deep research. Optional; without it the engine falls back to built-in web search.

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.title: Firecrawl API key
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.description: Used for structured extraction from company websites and page monitoring. Optional.

FIRECRAWL_BASE_URL.title: Firecrawl base URL
FIRECRAWL_BASE_URL.description: Only set this when you self-host Firecrawl (e.g. http://localhost:3002).

DEFAULT_RUN_BUDGET_USD.title: Default budget per run (USD)
DEFAULT_RUN_BUDGET_USD.description: Hard cap on provider spend per run unless the workspace config overrides it.
